versions.changelog:
Initial release of email-verification skill using BounceBan API.

- Enables verification of single or bulk email addresses, including catch-all and SEG-protected emails.
- Supports fast checks for free, disposable, role-based addresses, and delivers deliverability scores.
- Integrates credits and rate-limit management; requires BOUNCEBAN_API_KEY.
- Includes webhook support and extensive error handling guidelines.
- Clear endpoint guide and usage recipes provided for common verification tasks.
